title: [CD] Nightly -full CUDA wheels are not importable due to nvshmem dependency
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

+ python -c 'import torch'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/opt/python/cp311-cp311/lib/python3.11/site-packages/torch/__init__.py", line 415, in <module>
    from torch._C import *  # noqa: F403
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ImportError: /opt/python/cp311-cp311/lib/python3.11/site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch_nvshmem.so: undefined symbol: nvshmem_malloc, version NVSHMEM

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17062839319/job/48384485738 

### Versions

linux-binary-manywheel / manywheel-py3_11-cuda12_8-full-test / test
